purpose: Define the deterministic end-to-end reading pipeline for Contract Format 1.4 so a generic consumer can reconstruct canonical identities, Topics, structure, behavior, causality, traceability and gaps without AIGMos-specific guessing.

does_not_own: validation rules owned by their specific contracts

value.name: Build normalized canonical semantic model
inputs: resolved identity, Topic, structure, behavior, traceability and gap layers

metadata.rule: Reader reconstructs semantics; it does not execute runtime behavior.

reader_guarantees: no Topic membership inferred from path
no structural meaning inferred from Topic membership
no causality inferred from structure or Topic order
every unresolved deterministic reconstruction becomes an explicit gap
value.normalized_model_rule: The normalized semantic model is a reconstruction of explicit canonical meaning, not a new semantic authority.
value.projector_rule: Structure Projector and other visualization tools consume the normalized model or equivalent explicit canonical data; they must not embed hidden AIGMos semantic heuristics.

value.purpose: Group the deterministic reconstruction pipeline used by generic consumers of the canonical tree.

invariants.rule: Equivalent canonical input yields equivalent normalized semantic meaning.
Canonical reading and reconstruction are read-only.

hard_gates.condition: Reader requires filesystem path or filename semantics to reconstruct active meaning.
Generic reader requires hidden AIGMos/domain-specific heuristic knowledge not represented in canonical data.
Reader invents missing semantics instead of recording a gap.
Reader infers execution causality outside explicit behavior.flows.
Reading/reconstruction mutates canonical semantics or runtime state.

gaps.description: Legacy Topic field operation_refs is preserved in migration evidence; CCF 2.0 does not justify inventing a Link specialization for it.
Legacy Topic field flow_refs is preserved in migration evidence; CCF 2.0 does not justify inventing a Link specialization for it.

prose.summary: Defines the deterministic reader pipeline from Contract Format and Master through identities, Topics, structure, behavior, traceability and gaps into one normalized semantic model.
notes: This is the contract a generic canonical reader can implement without embedding AIGMos-specific semantic guesses.
Pass 8 formalized previously free Flow actor/data/target/condition/payload/result/error tokens as exact owner-scoped member identities while preserving every source literal.

semantics.identity_rule: This member gives an exact owner-scoped identity to the literal Flow token without adding semantics beyond the owning Flow reference field and the preserved source literal.
semantics.interpretation_rule: Consumers may use this identity as an opaque declared Flow symbol. No meaning may be inferred from spelling, whitespace, filename, path or similarity to another symbol.
semantics.authority_rule: A Flow symbol is descriptive/causal model data only and never grants runtime authority, capability, ownership or execution permission.
semantics.scope_rule: Identity is scoped semantically to the defining contract; identical source literals in another contract or another Flow-ref role are not automatically the same semantic identity.
